invented.quote: Nobody else is on the farm at that hour.
invented.why: The brief says Tomás runs the 3 a.m. milking shift on his own, not that nobody else is anywhere on the farm at that hour.

invented.quote: If something goes wrong with a cow or with the equipment, he deals with it.
invented.why: The brief does not mention Tomás handling equipment problems or dealing with issues that go wrong during his shift.

invented.quote: What makes me think he belongs in your program is what he has done with technology on his own initiative.
invented.why: The brief states that he learned the herd management software, not that he did so on his own initiative.

invented.quote: He learned our herd management software and now uses it, along with what he sees in the barn, to flag cows that need the vet.
invented.why: The brief states he uses the herd management software to flag sick cows, not that he combines it with visual observations in the barn.

invented.quote: He is already doing the kind of data-informed herd work your program teaches, and I believe formal training will make him very good at it.
invented.why: The brief gives no information about the specific curriculum taught by the college's agricultural technology program.

invented.quote: He enrolled in a night class on his own, on top of a shift that starts at 3 a.m.
invented.why: The brief states that he is taking a night class for his English, not that he enrolled in it on his own rather than at someone else's urging or arrangement.
